class ZipFile
  class << self
    def create_for(attachment, filename:)
      raise ArgumentError, "No block given" unless block_given?

      reflection = attachment.record.class.reflect_on_attachment(attachment.name)
      service_name = reflection.options[:service_name] || ActiveStorage::Blob.service.name
      service = ActiveStorage::Blob.services.fetch(service_name)

      if s3_service?(service)
        create_for_s3(attachment, filename: filename, service: service) { |zip| yield zip }
      else
        create_for_disk(attachment, filename: filename) { |zip| yield zip }
      end
    end

    def open(blob)
      io = io_for(blob)
      reader = Reader.new(io)
      yield reader
    ensure
      io.close if io.respond_to?(:close) && !(io.respond_to?(:closed?) && io.closed?)
    end

    private
      def io_for(blob)
        service = blob.service

        if service.respond_to?(:path_for)
          File.open(service.path_for(blob.key), "rb")
        else
          ZipKit::RemoteIO.new(blob.url(expires_in: 12.hours))
        end
      end

      def s3_service?(service)
        # The S3 service doesn't get loaded in development unless it's used
        defined?(ActiveStorage::Service::S3Service) && service.is_a?(ActiveStorage::Service::S3Service)
      end

      def create_for_s3(attachment, filename:, service:)
        blob = ActiveStorage::Blob.create_before_direct_upload!(
          filename: filename,
          content_type: "application/zip",
          byte_size: 0,
          checksum: "pending"
        )

        writer = Writer.new

        # Use S3's upload_stream directly for write-based streaming.
        # ActiveStorage's upload method expects a read-based IO, but ZipKit
        # needs a write-based stream. The TransferManager's upload_stream
        # yields a writable IO that we can stream directly to.
        service.send(:upload_stream,
          key: blob.key,
          content_type: "application/zip",
          part_size: 100.megabytes
        ) do |write_stream|
          write_stream.binmode
          writer.stream_to(write_stream)
          yield writer
          writer.close
        end

        blob.update!(byte_size: writer.byte_size, checksum: writer.checksum)
        attachment.attach(blob)
      rescue Aws::S3::MultipartUploadError => e
        if e.errors.any?
          raise e.errors.first
        else
          raise e
        end
      end

      def create_for_disk(attachment, filename:)
        tempfile = Tempfile.new([ "export", ".zip" ])
        tempfile.binmode

        writer = Writer.new(tempfile)
        yield writer
        writer.close

        tempfile.rewind
        attachment.attach(io: tempfile, filename: filename, content_type: "application/zip")
      ensure
        tempfile&.close
        tempfile&.unlink
      end

  end
end
EOF

class Account::DataTransfer::RecordSet
  INTERNAL_RECORD_TYPES = %w[ Export Import ].freeze
  BATCH_SIZE = 500

  attr_reader :account, :model, :attributes

  def initialize(account:, model:, attributes: nil)
    @account = account
    @model = model
    @attributes = (attributes || model.column_names).map(&:to_s)
  end

  def export_to(zip)
    with_zip(zip) do
      each_record do |record|
        write_record(record)
      end
    end
  end

  def import_into(zip, transfer)
    with_zip(zip) do
      batch = []

      each_exported_path do |path|
        payload = JSON.parse(zip.read(path))
        next unless import_payload?(payload, transfer)

        batch << attributes_for_insert(payload, transfer)

        if batch.size >= BATCH_SIZE
          insert_batch(batch)
          batch = []
        end
      end

      insert_batch(batch) if batch.any?
    end
  end

  def each_exported_id(zip)
    with_zip(zip) do
      each_exported_path do |path|
        yield File.basename(path, ".json")
      end
    end
  end

  private
    attr_reader :zip

    def with_zip(zip)
      old_zip = @zip
      @zip = zip
      yield
    ensure
      @zip = old_zip
    end

    def records
      model.where(account_id: account.id)
    end

    def model_dir
      model.table_name
    end

    def each_record
      relation = records

      if relation.respond_to?(:find_each)
        relation.find_each { |record| yield record }
      else
        Array(relation).each { |record| yield record }
      end
    end

    def write_record(record)
      zip.add_file("#{model_dir}/#{record.id}.json", JSON.generate(serialize(record)))
    end

    def serialize(record)
      attributes.index_with { |name| json_value(record.read_attribute(name)) }
    end

    def json_value(value)
      case value
      when Time, DateTime, Date, ActiveSupport::TimeWithZone
        value.iso8601(6)
      else
        value
      end
    end

    def each_exported_path
      zip.glob("#{model_dir}/*.json").each { |path| yield path }
    end

    def import_payload?(payload, transfer)
      true
    end

    def attributes_for_insert(payload, transfer)
      remapped = {}

      attributes.each do |name|
        remapped[name] = database_value(name, remap(payload[name], transfer, name))
      end

      remapped["id"] = transfer.id_for(payload["id"]) if payload["id"]
      remapped["account_id"] = transfer.account.id if remapped.key?("account_id")
      transform_for_import(remapped, payload, transfer)
    end

    def transform_for_import(attributes, payload, transfer)
      attributes
    end

    def remap(value, transfer, key = nil)
      case value
      when Hash
        value.each_with_object({}) do |(child_key, child_value), result|
          result[child_key] = remap(child_value, transfer, child_key)
        end
      when Array
        value.map { |child| remap(child, transfer, key) }
      when String
        remap_string(value, transfer, key)
      else
        value
      end
    end

    def remap_string(value, transfer, key)
      if id_reference?(key) && transfer.mapped?(value)
        transfer.id_for(value)
      else
        value
      end
    end

    def id_reference?(key)
      name = key.to_s
      name == "id" || name.end_with?("_id") || name.end_with?("_ids")
    end

    def database_value(name, value)
      column = model.columns_hash[name]
      return value unless column

      case column.type
      when :json
        value
      when :text, :string
        if value.is_a?(Hash) || value.is_a?(Array)
          JSON.generate(value)
        else
          value
        end
      else
        value
      end
    end

    def insert_batch(rows)
      model.insert_all(rows)
    end
end
EOF

class Account::DataTransfer::Importer
  def initialize(zip, importer:)
    @zip = zip
    @importer = importer
    @id_map = {}
    @blob_keys = {}
    @uploaded_keys = []
    @created_identity_ids = []
  end

  def perform
    account = nil

    begin
      validate!
      account = create_account
      assign_ids
      import_records
      ensure_importer_membership
      account
    rescue
      Account::DataTransfer::Cleanup.purge(
        account,
        uploaded_keys: @uploaded_keys,
        created_identity_ids: @created_identity_ids
      )
      raise
    end.tap do |imported|
      finalize(imported)
    end
  end

  def account
    @account
  end

  def mapped?(id)
    @id_map.key?(id)
  end

  def id_for(id)
    @id_map[id]
  end

  def blob_key_for(old_key)
    @blob_keys[old_key] ||= ActiveStorage::Blob.generate_unique_secure_token
  end

  def each_blob_key
    @blob_keys.each { |old_key, new_key| yield old_key, new_key }
  end

  def note_uploaded_key(key)
    @uploaded_keys << key
  end

  def note_created_identity(identity)
    @created_identity_ids << identity.id
  end

  private
    attr_reader :zip, :importer

    def validate!
      raise Account::DataTransfer::Error, "This file isn't a Fizzy account export." unless zip.exists?("manifest.json")

      manifest = JSON.parse(zip.read("manifest.json"))

      unless manifest["kind"] == "account"
        raise Account::DataTransfer::Error, "This file isn't a Fizzy account export."
      end

      if manifest["version"].to_i > Account::DataTransfer::VERSION
        raise Account::DataTransfer::Error, "This export was made by a newer Fizzy and can't be imported here."
      end
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      raise Account::DataTransfer::Error, "This file isn't a Fizzy account export."
    end

    def create_account
      payload = account_payload
      new_id = ActiveRecord::Type::Uuid.generate
      @id_map[payload["id"]] = new_id

      @account = Account.create!(
        id: new_id,
        name: payload["name"].presence || "Imported account",
        cards_count: payload["cards_count"] || 0,
        created_at: payload["created_at"],
        updated_at: payload["updated_at"]
      )
      @account.entropy&.delete
      @account
    end

    def account_payload
      paths = zip.glob("accounts/*.json")
      raise Account::DataTransfer::Error, "The export is missing its account." unless paths.one?

      JSON.parse(zip.read(paths.first))
    end

    def assign_ids
      manifest.each_record_set do |record_set|
        record_set.each_exported_id(zip) do |old_id|
          @id_map[old_id] ||= ActiveRecord::Type::Uuid.generate
        end
      end
    end

    def import_records
      manifest.each_record_set do |record_set|
        record_set.import_into(zip, self)
      end
    end

    def ensure_importer_membership
      return if importer.blank?

      if user = account.users.find_by(identity: importer)
        user.update!(active: true, verified_at: user.verified_at || Time.current) unless user.active? && user.verified?
      else
        user = account.users.create!(
          identity: importer,
          name: importer_name,
          role: :owner,
          verified_at: Time.current
        )
      end

      grant_access_to_all_boards(user)
    end

    def importer_name
      importer.users.where.not(name: [ nil, "" ]).pick(:name) || importer.email_address
    end

    def grant_access_to_all_boards(user)
      account.boards.find_each do |board|
        board.accesses.grant_to(user) unless board.accessible_to?(user)
      end
    end

    def finalize(imported)
      reindex(imported)
      reconcile_storage(imported)
    rescue => error
      Rails.error.report(error)
    end

    def reindex(imported)
      Card.where(account: imported).published.find_each(&:reindex)
      Comment.joins(:card).merge(Card.where(account: imported).published).find_each(&:reindex)
    end

    def reconcile_storage(imported)
      imported.boards.find_each(&:reconcile_storage)
      imported.reconcile_storage
    end

    def manifest
      @manifest ||= Account::DataTransfer::Manifest.new(account)
    end
end

class Account::DataTransfer::ActionText::RichTextRecordSet < Account::DataTransfer::RecordSet
  def initialize(account)
    super(account: account, model: ::ActionText::RichText)
  end

  private
    def records
      ::ActionText::RichText.where(account: account)
    end

    def serialize(record)
      payload = super
      payload["body"] = portable_body(payload["body"])
      payload
    end

    def transform_for_import(attributes, payload, transfer)
      attributes["body"] = restore_body(attributes["body"], transfer)
      attributes
    end

    def portable_body(html)
      return html if html.blank?

      fragment = Nokogiri::HTML.fragment(html)
      fragment.css("action-text-attachment").each do |node|
        next unless node["sgid"]

        if record = locate_attachable(node["sgid"])
          node["export-gid"] = record.to_global_id.to_s
          node.remove_attribute("sgid")
          node.remove_attribute("url")
        end
      end
      fragment.to_html
    end

    def restore_body(html, transfer)
      return html if html.blank?

      fragment = Nokogiri::HTML.fragment(html)
      fragment.css("action-text-attachment").each do |node|
        next unless node["export-gid"]

        if sgid = resign(node["export-gid"], transfer)
          node["sgid"] = sgid
        end

        node.remove_attribute("export-gid")
      end
      fragment.to_html
    end

    def locate_attachable(sgid)
      GlobalID::Locator.locate_signed(sgid, for: "attachable")
    rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound, ActiveSupport::MessageVerifier::InvalidSignature
      nil
    end

    def resign(gid_string, transfer)
      gid = GlobalID.parse(gid_string)
      return unless gid

      new_id = transfer.id_for(gid.model_id)
      return unless new_id

      gid.model_class.new(id: new_id).to_sgid(expires_in: nil, for: "attachable").to_s
    rescue NameError
      nil
    end
end

class Account::DataTransfer::CardExport
  def initialize(user)
    @user = user
  end

  def export_to(zip)
    paths = cards.map { |card| export_card(zip, card) }

    zip.add_file("manifest.json", JSON.generate(
      version: Account::DataTransfer::VERSION,
      kind: "cards",
      exported_at: Time.current.iso8601,
      cards: paths
    ))
  end

  private
    attr_reader :user

    def cards
      published_ids = user.accessible_cards.published.ids
      draft_ids = user.accessible_cards.drafted.where(creator: user).ids

      Card.where(id: published_ids + draft_ids)
        .includes(:board, :column, :tags, :creator, :assignees, :image_attachment, comments: [ :creator ])
        .with_rich_text_description
        .order(:number)
    end

    def export_card(zip, card)
      files = export_files(zip, card)
      path = "cards/#{card.number}.json"

      zip.add_file(path, JSON.pretty_generate(card_payload(card, files)))
      path
    end

    def card_payload(card, files)
      {
        id: card.id,
        number: card.number,
        title: card.title,
        status: card.status,
        description: card.description.to_plain_text,
        description_html: card.description.to_s,
        board: { id: card.board_id, name: card.board.name },
        column: card.column && { id: card.column_id, name: card.column.name },
        creator: person(card.creator),
        assignees: card.assignees.map { |assignee| person(assignee) },
        tags: card.tags.map(&:title).sort,
        created_at: card.created_at.iso8601,
        updated_at: card.updated_at.iso8601,
        files: files[:card],
        comments: card.comments.chronologically.map do |comment|
          comment_payload(comment, files[:comments].fetch(comment.id, []))
        end
      }
    end

    def comment_payload(comment, files)
      {
        id: comment.id,
        body: comment.body.to_plain_text,
        body_html: comment.body.to_s,
        creator: person(comment.creator),
        created_at: comment.created_at.iso8601,
        updated_at: comment.updated_at.iso8601,
        files: files
      }
    end

    def person(user)
      return unless user

      {
        id: user.id,
        name: user.name,
        email_address: user.identity&.email_address
      }
    end

    def export_files(zip, card)
      card_files = []
      comment_files = {}

      if card.image.attached?
        card_files << write_blob(zip, card, card.image.blob, "image-")
      end

      card.attachments.each do |attachment|
        card_files << write_blob(zip, card, attachment.blob, "file-")
      end

      card.comments.each do |comment|
        comment_files[comment.id] = comment.attachments.filter_map do |attachment|
          write_blob(zip, card, attachment.blob, "comment-#{comment.id}-") if attachment.blob
        end
      end

      { card: card_files, comments: comment_files }
    end

    def write_blob(zip, card, blob, prefix)
      return unless blob

      path = "files/#{card.number}/#{prefix}#{blob.id}-#{blob.filename}"
      zip.add_file(path, compress: false) do |sink|
        blob.download { |chunk| sink.write(chunk) }
      end
      path
    end
end

        host: request.host,
        port: request.port

  INTERNAL_RECORD_TYPES = %w[ Export Import ].freeze
  BATCH_SIZE = 500

  attr_reader :account, :model, :attributes

  def initialize(account:, model:, attributes: nil)
    @account = account
    @model = model
    @attributes = (attributes || model.column_names).map(&:to_s)
  end

  def export_to(zip)
    with_zip(zip) do
      each_record do |record|
        write_record(record)
      end
    end
  end

  def import_into(zip, transfer)
    with_zip(zip) do
      batch = []

      each_exported_path do |path|
        payload = JSON.parse(zip.read(path))
        next unless import_payload?(payload, transfer)

        batch << attributes_for_insert(payload, transfer)

        if batch.size >= BATCH_SIZE
          insert_batch(batch)
          batch = []
        end
      end

      insert_batch(batch) if batch.any?
    end
  end

  def each_exported_id(zip)
    with_zip(zip) do
      each_exported_path do |path|
        yield File.basename(path, ".json")
      end
    end
  end

  private
    attr_reader :zip

    def with_zip(zip)
      old_zip = @zip
      @zip = zip
      yield
    ensure
      @zip = old_zip
    end

    def records
      model.where(account_id: account.id)
    end

    def model_dir
      model.table_name
    end

    def each_record
      relation = records

      if relation.respond_to?(:find_each)
        relation.find_each { |record| yield record }
      else
        Array(relation).each { |record| yield record }
      end
    end

    def write_record(record)
      zip.add_file("#{model_dir}/#{record.id}.json", JSON.generate(serialize(record)))
    end

    def serialize(record)
      attributes.index_with { |name| json_value(record.read_attribute(name)) }
    end

    def json_value(value)
      case value
      when Time, ActiveSupport::TimeWithZone
        value.iso8601(6)
      when ActionText::Content
        value.to_s
      when Date
        value.iso8601
      else
        value
      end
    end

    def each_exported_path
      zip.glob("#{model_dir}/*.json").each { |path| yield path }
    end

    def import_payload?(payload, transfer)
      true
    end

    def attributes_for_insert(payload, transfer)
      remapped = {}

      attributes.each do |name|
        remapped[name] = database_value(name, remap(payload[name], transfer, name))
      end

      remapped["id"] = transfer.id_for(payload["id"]) if payload["id"]
      remapped["account_id"] = transfer.account.id if remapped.key?("account_id")
      transform_for_import(remapped, payload, transfer)
    end

    def transform_for_import(attributes, payload, transfer)
      attributes
    end

    def remap(value, transfer, key = nil)
      case value
      when Hash
        value.each_with_object({}) do |(child_key, child_value), result|
          result[child_key] = remap(child_value, transfer, child_key)
        end
      when Array
        value.map { |child| remap(child, transfer, key) }
      when String
        remap_string(value, transfer, key)
      else
        value
      end
    end

    def remap_string(value, transfer, key)
      if id_reference?(key) && transfer.mapped?(value)
        transfer.id_for(value)
      else
        value
      end
    end

    def id_reference?(key)
      name = key.to_s
      name == "id" || name.end_with?("_id") || name.end_with?("_ids")
    end

    def database_value(name, value)
      type = model.type_for_attribute(name)
      column = model.columns_hash[name]
      return value unless column

      if serialized_type?(type) || column.type == :json
        coerce_serialized(value)
      elsif value.is_a?(Hash) || value.is_a?(Array)
        JSON.generate(value)
      else
        value
      end
    end

    def serialized_type?(type)
      defined?(ActiveRecord::Type::Serialized) && type.is_a?(ActiveRecord::Type::Serialized)
    end

    def coerce_serialized(value)
      if value.is_a?(String) && (value.start_with?("[") || value.start_with?("{"))
        JSON.parse(value)
      else
        value
      end
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      value
    end

    def insert_batch(rows)
      model.insert_all(rows)
    end
end

class Export < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :account
  belongs_to :user

  has_one_attached :file, dependent: :purge_later

  enum :kind, %w[ account cards ].index_by(&:itself)
  enum :status, %w[ pending processing ready failed ].index_by(&:itself), default: :pending

  validates :kind, :status, presence: true

  def process_later
    Export::ProcessJob.perform_later(self)
  end

  def process_now
    return if ready? || failed?

    update!(status: :processing)
    build_file
    update!(status: :ready, expires_at: 1.day.from_now)
    ExportMailer.ready(self).deliver_later
  rescue => error
    update!(status: :failed, failure_reason: error.message.to_s.truncate(1_000))
    ExportMailer.failed(self).deliver_later
    Rails.error.report(error)
  end

  def expired?
    expires_at.blank? || expires_at.past?
  end

  def filename
    if cards?
      "#{user.name.parameterize}-cards.zip"
    else
      "#{account.name.parameterize}-export.zip"
    end
  end

class Import < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :account
  belongs_to :user
  belongs_to :imported_account, class_name: "Account", optional: true

  has_one_attached :file, dependent: :purge_later

  enum :status, %w[ pending processing completed failed ].index_by(&:itself), default: :pending

  validates :status, presence: true

  def process_later
    Import::ProcessJob.perform_later(self)
  end

  def process_now
    return if completed? || failed?

    update!(status: :processing)
    imported = import_account

    ImportMailer.completed(self).deliver_later
  rescue => error
